study type: secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: symptom severity: minimal symptoms (<=1 on each O'Leary/Sant Interstitial Cystitis Symptom Index (ICSI) subscore and without history of IC/BPS) vs highly symptomatic (composite ICSI score >=12 and a Burning/Pain subscore of 4 or 5)
cohort: 84 women undergoing routine gynecologic procedures who were consented for cystoscopy with hydrodistension (CWHD).
finding: Women with minimal urinary symptoms had an eight-fold lower prevalence of significant glomerulations than highly symptomatic women.
